picker-title._comment: Standalone ROOT-prefix component (own .vue file, own IPickerTitleProps) — see the 'ROOT prefix' listing in typography.composable.ts. NOT a BEM child of `picker`: it owns its own top-level token file so its var prefix (`--origam-picker-title---*`) matches what OrigamPickerTitle.vue already reads, instead of nesting under `picker` and producing a `--origam-picker__title---*` / `--origam-picker--title---*` name the component never asked for (issue #433). Values below are the literal defaults the component already renders today, carried over unchanged so wiring this channel does not also change the render.
